description: Run a Salesforce report asynchronously (POST /analytics/reports/{id}/instances). Returns an instance id and status; the report runs in the background. Retrieve results later with get_report_instance using the returned instance id. Use this (instead of the synchronous run_report) for large reports or to avoid blocking. Without this action, get_report_instance had no obtainable instance id.

include_details.description: If true, the async run includes detailed (row-level) results in addition to aggregates. Passed as the includeDetails query parameter.
include_details.title: Include Details

report_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the report to run asynchronously.
report_id.title: Report Id

report_metadata.description: Optional reportMetadata object to override the report's filters/settings for this run only (e.g. reportFilters, standardDateFilter). Sent as the request body when provided.
report_metadata.title: Report Metadata

name: run_report_async

RunReportAsyncResponse.description: Metadata for the asynchronous report run instance.

completionDate.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the run completed. Null until finished.
completionDate.title: Completion Date

hasDetailRows.description: Whether the instance includes detail (row-level) rows.
hasDetailRows.title: Has Detail Rows

id.description: The instance ID for this async run. Poll get_report_instance with this id (and the report_id) to retrieve results once status is 'Success'.
id.title: Id

ownerId.description: ID of the user who requested the async run.
ownerId.title: Owner Id

queryOptions.description: Query options applied to the run, if any.
queryOptions.title: Query Options

requestDate.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the run was requested.
requestDate.title: Request Date

url.description: Relative URL of this instance for fetching results.
url.title: Url

RunReportAsyncResponse.title: RunReportAsyncResponse
